verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's docs say it has its own 'ChatGPT data controls' that apply to processed content, including Computer Use screenshots. The Codex CLI `/memories` command also lets a user stop a chat from feeding future memories, a narrow form of controlling what is retained. Neither item describes retention periods or how to delete data, so support is thin. Missing for 10: documented retention-period settings, chat/data deletion controls, account data deletion or export, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Your ChatGPT data controls apply to content processed through ChatGPT, including screenshots taken by Computer Use.
use /memories in an interactive session to control whether the current chat can use existing local memories or become an input for future memories
